_comment: Bible verses the Keepers drop into their overheard conversation, picked by Miro's current leaning (scripts/player_behavior.gd). Verses are King James Version (public domain). Two lines per exchange: speaker 0 then speaker 1 of the floor's main conversation. One exchange per floor (Levels 2-4 have conversations), chosen by floor number. They are guards' talk, so the verse is half-remembered, argued with, or used as a joke; never a sermon aimed at the player.

ghost.text: Chaplain pinned a verse over the stairs. 'Whither shall I flee from thy presence?' Psalm 139.
Somebody should tell him. Because M-07 found somewhere.
'The darkness hideth not from thee.' My mother used to say that at bedtime.
Then she never worked a night shift in this place. Check the vents.

blackhat.text: Luke 8. 'Nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest.'
Tell that to the cameras. Half of them went dark and nobody signed for it.
'Men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.' John 3.
Is that about him or about the people who switched the cameras off?

defiant.text: 'All they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.' Matthew 26. Remember it.
He took a shank, not a sword. And he's not the one perishing.
Eye for eye, tooth for tooth. That's in there too, you know.
'Vengeance is mine, saith the Lord.' Not yours. Not his either.

survivor.text: 'Troubled on every side, yet not distressed. Cast down, but not destroyed.'
Second Corinthians. You read that about yourself, or about him?
'Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death...'
He walked through two alarms and a firing line. Fear no evil, apparently.

seeker.text: 'Seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened.' Matthew 7.
Not in here it won't. They changed the locks on the records room.
'Ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.'
Keep that one off the walls. The Ward doesn't like truth on the walls.

neutral.text: 'Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them.' Hebrews 13.
We are bound with them. Same air, same cough.
Isaiah 61. 'To proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison.'
Don't read that one out loud down here.
